nixpkgs.reason: The niri flake selects the wrong libdisplay-info version for each niri source's Cargo.lock, causing a broken build, and the fix (PR #1853) remains open with no new upstream movement.

recommendation.recommendation: Switch the niri flake input from `sodiboo/niri-flake` to `epireyn/niri-flake`, which the upstream niri maintainers endorsed and merged into the project's Getting Started guide.
recommendation.basis: sodiboo (maintainer of `sodiboo/niri-flake`) APPROVED niri-wm/niri#4404 and explicitly stated he is no longer keeping his flake up to date and is fine with pointing users to an actively-maintained alternative (17 hearts on that comment); YaLTeR (maintainer of `niri-wm/niri`) co-managed the PR, which was merged 2026-08-13. A competing suggestion by bugeats (no role, PR author on the tracked issue) to use their own fork `bugeats/niri-flake` collected 3 +1 reactions but ranks lower because it is a single unendorsed fork (0 stars, no maintainer involvement) versus the maintainer-approved, merged upstream recommendation. Caveat from the endorsed party: epireyn (no role) confirmed they will only update the flake after a niri release is published and based solely on its changelog, so the delay between a release and the flake update may be longer than with the original.
